model: Same 19-parameter finite hard-edge solenoid column; known MAGICAL intensity pattern
method: Signed displacements fit the 16 optical parameters; all responses then fit all 19. No soft penalties in either stage; original hard bounds retained.
design: Retrospective data-Jacobian backward elimination using previous fitted model and observed covariances. A second design retains at least four moderate mixed-projector settings and two compensated-objective settings.
pilot_acceptance: All 20 starts agree within 0.01 chi-squared and 0.1% in named parameters; RMS below 1.5; no active bounds; maximum local relative standard error below 1%.
final_choice: Eleven settings chosen after pilot exploration: all 20 starts agree and maximum local relative standard error below 0.5%. Frozen before new seeds 7301, 8301 and 7401.
